svg.title: Worldtide Confluence — Three-channel ancient gate
svg.desc: Three channel anchors belong to the outer solo loop. A separately marked inner gate leads to the Regent; service galleries and rescue ropes remain outside its arena. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
